grammar.description: immune_contracts.grammar regex. scope=param: values NOT matching are suspect. scope=param_present: values NOT matching are denied when the clone is inconclusive. null with scope=all.

scope.description: param: only values outside grammar. param_present: every request that carries the parameter, whatever its value. all: every request on the route.

identity.description: optional. untrusted: the rule applies only to anonymous/untrusted callers, not authenticated ones (missing-authentication containment, CWE-306). Absent: every identity.

ttl_s.description: null or absent: the rule lives until it is deleted (patch verified, or by hand).
